concerns.text: T024 (Lagged Alignment) depends on T023 (Behavioral Binning) output, but T023 is listed AFTER T024 in the task sequence. T024 requires `data/accuracy_blocks.csv` (from T023) to align MMN windows, yet T024 appears before T023 in the list, violating producer-before-consumer ordering.

T026 (Finalize Aligned Dataset) depends on T025 (Exclusion logic) and T016 (Underpowered subjects). T025 is listed after T024 but before T026, which is correct, but T026 also explicitly requires `excluded_subjects.csv` from T016 (Phase 3). While T016 is earlier, the dependency chain T023->T024->T025->T026 is broken by the placement of T024 before T023.

T012 (Contract test for data schema) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly states 'Dependency: Requires T009a/b completion'. While T009a/b are in the same phase, marking T012 as [P] implies it can run independently of T009a/b completion, which is false. It must wait for schema files to exist.

T013 (Integration test) is marked [P] but depends on T009a/b (schemas) AND T014/T015 (ingestion/preprocessing logic) to actually run a pipeline test. Marking it [P] suggests it can run in parallel with T014/T015, but it cannot function without their output artifacts.

T023 defines '10-trial blocks' for accuracy, but the spec (FR-005) and plan only define the 50-trial source window for MMN. The 10-trial target block size is an arbitrary parameter introduced in the task without a clear dependency on a prior decision artifact, creating a potential semantic gap in the data flow definition.
